_about: What's new cards for the builder page (newest first). Plain words only: no file names, commits, secrets or workflow names. CHANGELOG.md is the developer history and shows under each card's Technical details.

versions.title: The tools have a new address

items.text: The Builder, KPI admin and Review admin now live at dashboard.lawfirmmarketingpros.com. Old peejayedz.github.io links still work: they forward to the new address.
New KPI dashboard and review links use the new address. Links saved earlier on the old address are still accepted and keep working.

versions.title: Review links named like the Review admin

items.text: On a client's Review card and the Overview tab, the two review links are now called Link A · Plan + review and Link B · Review only, the same names as in the Review admin.

versions.title: Find the client in GHL instead of typing

items.text: New sub-account now starts with two choices: Find client in GHL, or Enter details manually. Switching between them keeps what you typed.

Search LFMP's CRM by name, firm or email. You see the search working step by step (about 30 seconds), then up to 10 matches with their LFMP or WPP client tag, and a warning if that client already has a sub-account.

Use this client fills the form: business name, phone, website, address, time zone, primary contact and brand. Filled fields say From GHL, the ones still missing are highlighted, and everything stays editable.
Pressing Create now opens a short summary to check first. Nothing is created until you press Yes, create sub-account.
Clients filled from GHL get a Client in LFMP CRM link in their details.

versions.title: The old Builder password is gone

items.text: The Builder now signs in only with the shared admin password (the same as the KPI admin and Review). The old Builder-only password and its screen were removed.
If 30 minutes pass without activity, the next click locks straight away (it could take up to 15 seconds).

versions.title: One login for all three tools, and a colour for each

items.text: One admin password now opens the Builder, the KPI admin and the Review admin. Sign in once and move between them from the top menu without being asked again.
Each tool has its own colour so you always know where you are: gold for the Builder, red for the KPI admin, teal for Review. Main buttons stay gold.
Clients · KPI admin · Review open in the same window. Lock on any tool locks all three; 30 minutes without activity locks too.
After 5 wrong passwords in a row, sign-in pauses for 2 minutes with a countdown. "Forgot password?" explains how to set a new one.
One GitHub token is shared with the KPI admin, so you connect it once.

versions.title: A new look, and every client at a glance

items.text: One status per client (Needs attention, Setting up, Waiting to start, All set) with a KPI · Review · Forms line. A problem links straight to the fix, e.g. "KPI sync failed →".
Details open in a side panel. Overview shows what needs a look (with Retry), every link and the setup; KPI, Review and Forms have their own tabs, with a red count on one that needs a look.
A simpler home: GHL ↗ and Details → on every client, test clients hidden unless you tick Show tests, and Refresh list in the ⋯ menu.
The same look as the KPI admin page, in dark or light. Auto follows your Mac or iPhone; your choice is remembered.
The KPI card shows how far the setup got, keeps finished steps to one line, and says what Retry will do.
On the iPhone: client cards, a bottom bar and a big + New button.
What's new is readable again: one card per version, newest first.

versions.title: Review packages, KPI dashboards and the whole builder

items.text: Automation review packages: create a client's plan and messages from the LeadPro template, preview them, tailor the wording after the kickoff call, then publish them for Andy.
Bring changes made in GHL back into the review package, and see who changed a message: GHL, the builder, or both.
KPI dashboards set themselves up: tick the box and the dashboard, its mapping, the first sync and the GHL menu link are done for you.
Webforms tickets: set up the Zap, check the details and send the Desk ticket from the client's record.
Create GHL sub-accounts from a snapshot, with a live progress list and a record of every client and link.
Words brought in from GHL stay on their own line, and saves show who made them.
